craft_notes: Sthāyin: sun as knowledge-power. Rows: as-so-there. Read aloud: correspondence.

lines: As the Lord is compass-cleaver, so the sun —
for sire's own is wisdom's might, thus sung:
there, there, there the east is of the manifest from the east;
and just where, so there — thus self-ruled even, one's-own-place facing, in front.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yathā bhagavān digvibhāgakārī tathā sūryo 'pi sa hi pārameśvary eva jñānaśaktir ity uktaṃ tatra tatra tatra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ pūrvā yatraiva ca tathā tatraiva evaṃ svātmādhīnāpi svasammukhīnasya deśasya purastāttvāt
